title: Death Stranding is one the greatest open world experiences ever created
chunk: The game is intended to be played online and any infrastructure you're building is actually going towards helping other players.

title: Death Stranding is one the greatest open world experiences ever created
chunk: That road that you're building may appear in someone else's game, making their playthrough quite a bit easier.

title: Death Stranding is one the greatest open world experiences ever created
chunk: I think a lot of people missed this and played through the entire game wondering why it wasn't helping them in their playthroughs.
